facts.value: Initialization sets the subject Active, fills horizontal and vertical target extents, copies both into current extents, and initializes both position anchors. Normal refresh updates horizontal target extents, facing and position, clears on_ledge, and fetches bone_pos; it does not overwrite Active state, vertical target extents or current extents. The upper-boundary helper refreshes first, multiplies pos.x by (cameraTop-center.y)/(blastTop-center.y), and sets pos.y to blastTop. It does not subtract center.x or recompute bone_pos after projection. No fighter motion or gameplay timer is changed.
